messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-1960000001 — high 5xx rate on hosted-inference-prod (policy: inference-api-critical). Escalation level: PRIMARY -> SECONDARY in 5m if no ack. Links: https://pd.example/INC-1960000001 :rotating_light:
oncall-sre: seeing this, I'm on it. quick check — is this global or specific region?
alex: acked (I'll take primary). digging into gateway logs now.
jessica: flipping on the latency dashboard — seeing a ~3x increase in token tail latency and a spike in 502s from inference-gateway-2 in us-east-1. no obvious autoscale events.
oncall-sre: timeline: ~09:12 UTC spike starts, 09:18 PD alert triggers. alex, can you run a healthcheck against the model-serving pool?
alex: running quick curl against health endpoint:
```
curl -sS -D - https://inference-us-east1.redwood/api/v1/health | head -n 20
HTTP/2 502
content-type: application/json
{"status":"degraded","details":{"replicas_ok":43,"replicas_err":7,"avg_qps":5200}}
```
alex: logs show repeated KV cache errors from a subset of pods: `kv_cache: failed to load shard 3 -> timeout`. suspect bad SSD on node or kernel OOM.
jessica: customer impact: top 10 tenants show ~30% failures on generation endpoints; enterprise customers in us-east-1 with dedicated pools seeing timeouts. notified SF support rotation.
pd-bot: PagerDuty escalation: PRIMARY did not acknowledge within 5m; escalating to SECONDARY (ops-manager). PagerDuty link: https://pd.example/INC-1960000001/escalate :warning:
ops-manager: I'm awake, joining call. tagging infra to check node health and kube events. if it's SSD/kernel, start migrating affected replicas ASAP.
oncall-sre: agree. running: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Running` and `kubectl describe node ip-10-0-12-34` now. will paste relevant snippets.
alex: temporary mitigation: scaling down the broken pool (replicas from 50->30) and letting scheduler spin up new pods on different nodes. applying now.
jessica: creating customer-facing status note: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors for hosted inference in us-east-1. Some requests may fail or be delayed. We will provide updates every 15 minutes." posting to status.redwood.ai
ops-manager: prioritize failover for Dedicated customers — route their traffic to us-west-2 if possible. add automatic fallback in routing policy for the next 2 hours.
alex: rolled new pods, KV cache errors decreased in logs but tail latency still ~1.8x. rolling restart on two problematic nodes.
oncall-sre: observed one node with dmesg kernel OOM lines and `ext4` I/O errors — marking node cordoned, draining.
incident-bot: Incident timeline updated: primary ack by alex, PD escalation to ops-manager, mitigation: drain node ip-10-0-12-34, scale adjustments, customer notice published.
jessica: collecting post-incident data: top failing endpoints, percent errors by tenant, error traces. will start a short RCA doc in the incidents repo and ping infra for hardware replacement ticket.
ops-manager: good. after stabilization, let's run canary traffic for 15m, then reroute Dedicated back to us-east. @alex @jessica leave any follow-ups here and I'll coordinate a postmortem tomorrow 1700 UTC. :checkered_flag:
